name: in-app-assistant
title: In-app assistant
description: An assistant docked inside your existing app: a persistent side panel with kai-panel chrome, kai-view-stack drill into conversation history, composer slash and mention triggers, and the headless conversation controller over local storage. Ships with a scripted mock so the thread demos reasoning and a settled search_docs call on first paint.
docs: Runs against a scripted local mock out of the box - no endpoint, no key. The transport is one file, in-app-assistant.transport.ts: the scripted mock in the default mode, a POST to /api/chat with --gateway, a loud stub with --no-mock. Replace it with your own to go live, and keep parsing through the @kitn.ai/ui/wire readers. The host page content is a stand-in: keep the aside, replace the main region with your app.
